Create one wide extremely polished architectural illustration board with two panels and restrained English typography. Header: "CONCRETE LABYRINTH / ESCAPE REMAKE 01". Small subtitle: "SPATIAL CONCEPT — NOT TO SCALE".
LEFT PANEL 65%: a detailed axonometric sectional cutaway of a colossal enclosed brutalist concrete industrial megastructure wrapped around one truly bottomless central vertical shaft. Asymmetrical interconnected rooms stack on THREE elevations and fold around the void; massive continuous load-bearing piers disappear into black fog far below, no bottom plane, no floor under crossing acrobatics. Seven modest numbered room labels: 01 ENTRY at mid-left, 02 SWING COURT above-left, 03 CONVEYOR OBSERVATORY mid-right, 04 HANGING FOUNDRY lower-right, 05 HEAT GALLERY lower-left, 06 RETURN SPINE upper-left, 07 EXIT WORKS at upper-right. Warm ochre fine graphic arrows mark a proposed readable player loop between room interiors only, with small gaps for cannon trajectories and swinging bars. Existing circus mechanics embedded in industrial architecture: one brass human cannon sending a tiny human to a tightrope landing, two suspended horizontal grab bars attached to strong structure, a conveyor with moving grab bars viewed through a broad open span, portable trampoline on a suspended work island, discrete flame nozzles in a corridor, one hoist bridge and an exit cable workshop. These are deliberate mechanical stations, not random pipes. Show 3 or 4 tiny adult clothed human silhouettes for scale. Thick opaque concrete walls conceal pursuer transit completely; do NOT draw an exposed monster walkway or red navigation path. Only two glimpses of ONE huge humanoid pursuer in different conceptual encounter moments, a partial broad-shouldered silhouette through a remote vertical wall opening and a distant figure breaking out at a side balcony. Monster landing area is separated from cannon queue and landing pads.
RIGHT PANEL 35%: immersive eye-level key art from a protected cannon timing balcony looking over the bottomless shaft towards an industrial moving-bar conveyor and another concrete tower, a giant shadow half-obscured behind a distant slit. Strong readable silhouettes, clearly visible grab bar and landing edges, local warm industrial lamps, cold gray bounced ambient fill, soot, wet raw board-formed cement, modest rust, sparks and vapor away from aiming sightlines. Oppressive but not underexposed; no bright flat warehouse light. The architecture feels labyrinthine but structurally believable, with supported slabs and coherent rooms, not an Escher impossible staircase or floating rubble. Moody, severe, unknown factory purpose. No zombies, no hoods, no fantasy shrine ornamentation, no outdoor sky, no bottom safety floor, no videogame HUD, no visible pursuer service route. Beautiful professional environment concept artwork, clear sectional composition and realistic architectural material detail.
